messages:
maya: FYI canary run for lumen-int8 (q5-family quant) popped a reproducible multilingual regression. Quick numbers: BLEU -2.3, chrF -2.7, token count +4.1% on our standard multilocale suite. Mostly hits in zh/ja + sporadic RTL bracket mirroring in he/ar.
anil: ouch. do we have a tiny repro so i can diff tokenizer/detok behaviour?
yuki: dropping a couple minimal examples i saw in the failing bucket. baseline = lumen-fp16, candidate = lumen-int8-q5:
```
# chinese example
INPUT: "请把最新的会议记录（第3页）发给我。"
BASELINE: "请把最新的会议记录（第3页）发给我。"
CANDIDATE: "请把最新的会议记录 （第3页）发给我。"  # unexpected space before opening paren (U+0020 inserted)

# japanese example with ruby/parenthetical
INPUT: "明日の会議でふりがな（説明）を共有してください。"
BASELINE: "明日の会議でふりがな（説明）を共有してください。"
CANDIDATE: "明日の会議でふりがな （説明）を共有してください。"  # hair-space U+200A inserted before paren

# arabic/hebrew bracket orientation
INPUT: "הערות (דחוף) לשלוח למנהלים"
BASELINE: "הערות (דחוף) לשלוח למנהלים"
CANDIDATE: "הערות )דחוף( לשלוח למנהלים"  # brackets flipped/mirrored in detok
```

fara: thanks — can you paste token dumps for the chinese/japanese sample? looking for extra token ids mapping to narrow/hair-space codepoints.
maya: token dumps attached (baseline vs int8 candidate):
```
# zh baseline ids -> tokens: [4321, 210, 8766, 99] -> tokens: ["请把","最新的","会议记录","（第3页）"]
# zh candidate ids -> tokens: [4321,210,8766,99997,99] -> 99997 maps to "U+0020" (space) insertion

# ja baseline ids -> tokens: [7001,55,3300,880] -> tokens: ["明日の","会議で","\u00b","ふりがな（説明）"]
# ja candidate ids -> tokens: [7001,55,3300,88888,880] -> 88888 maps to U+200A (hair space)
```
ivan: infra note: this canary build enabled kernel-fusion-v3 and an experimental detok micro-optim (runtime flag enabled). quant was per-tensor asymmetric activation scaling (q5 config). both merged in same deploy.
anil: seems like two suspects: the quant scaling change (which can change logits near token boundaries) or the detok micro-opt (which touches unicode glue/space handling). we should bisect.
yuki: i kicked off a bisect over commits e5f9..b2c4 — isolating detok opt vs kernel fusion vs quant config. also queued a run where we take the int8 weights but force the legacy detok path (opt-out), to see if detok is the immediate cause.
canary-bot: canary summary: 1500 samples, 62 zh/ja whitespace insertions, 12 rtl bracket orientation diffs, delta BLEU -2.31, delta chrF -2.71. artifacts: s3://canary/lumen/3160702468/report.json.
fara: short-term mitigation: add an opt-out flag for the detok micro-opt in the lumen package config for canary customers, and gate the kernel-fusion-v3 behind a separate rollout. add a targeted unit test in tokenizer-regressions: assert no insertion of U+0020/U+200A around parentheses, brackets, and ruby markers.
maya: agreed. long-term: add a char-span -> token-span diff check into the onboarding smoke pipeline. if token count delta > 1.5% for locale X, fail the onboarding. also add a bidi orientation check for RTL samples (ensure bracket visual order preserves baseline).
ivan: i'll schedule the canary rollback window if we need immediate revert. also logging: expose token-boundary diffs in canary diagnostics UI so SREs can triage faster.
anil: let's also run the same candidate weights with asymmetric->symmetric quant switching to see if activation scaling style matters. run q4a int4 smoke as well to check bitwidth sensitivity.
yuki: running those next. will post bisect results when complete. add @platform-i18n to the reproducer issue for normalization sanity.
maya: opening the issue now with snippets, dumps, and the canary S3 link. tagging folks and adding short repro script. ping me to triage live. :thumbsup:
